item.title: Weekly Watch: Where Discernment Is Being Softened in the Church
item.description: In this Weekly Watch episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins examines subtle patterns reshaping biblical discernment in today's church, including language drift, cultural pressure, and discernment fatigue. Scripture calls believers to return to clarity, faithfulness, and confidence in Christ who is building His church.

item.title: Why False Teaching Appeals to the Human Heart
item.description: In this Contending for the Word Q&A episode, Dave Jenkins explains why false teaching appeals to the human heart and why it spreads so effectively. Drawing from 2 Timothy 4:3–4 and 2 Peter 2:18–19, this episode explores how deception connects with sinful desires, fears, and misplaced hopes and how believers can guard their hearts through the truth of God’s Word.

item.title: Psalm 28: When God Feels Silent — Trusting the Lord as Our Strength and Shield
item.description: Psalm 28 moves from urgent pleading to joyful praise. David cries out for God not to be silent, warns against the hypocrisy of the wicked, and celebrates the Lord as strength, shield, and saving refuge. This psalm points us to Christ, our Good Shepherd, who hears, helps, and carries His people forever.

item.title: How Christians Can Recognize and Resist Theological Drift
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how theological drift begins, what warning signs to watch for, and how Scripture calls believers to remain anchored in God's Word.

item.title: The Voice of the Lord: Worshiping the Sovereign King (Psalm 29)
item.description: Psalm 29 reveals the majesty and authority of God’s voice over creation. Learn how the Lord who thunders in power strengthens His people and blesses them with peace.

item.title: Created by God: A Biblical Response to Gender and Identity Confusion
item.description: The question of gender and identity is one of the most pressing discipleship issues facing the church today. In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains what the Bible teaches about gender, the image of God, and the significance of the human body.
